property_snapshot.Name: Horadric Cube
property_snapshot.Notes:
TYPE: Transmutation artifact (Diablo 2 mechanics integrated into campaign)

FUNCTION: Transmute items according to specific recipes. Items placed inside can be combined, upgraded, or broken down into components.

KNOWN RECIPES:
• 3 low runes → 1 mid rune
• 3 mid runes → 1 high rune
• Upgrade item quality
• Socket items
• Transmute gems/materials

SUCCESSFUL TRANSMUTATIONS:
• Ice Crown of Hrothgar → Winterheart Rune + Crown's Truth (Roll 19: Perfect)

TRANSMUTATION MECHANICS:
• d20 roll determines quality
• 1-3: Rejection
• 4-8: Partial transmutation
• 9-14: Standard transmutation
• 15-18: Enhanced transmutation
• 19-20: Perfect transmutation (reveals hidden nature)

CURRENT STATUS: Under study - learning transmutation principles. Basic transmutations understood, complex recipes being discovered through experimentation.

AVAILABLE RUNES: Eld, Tir, Tal, Ith, Nef (low tier), Ral, Shael (mid tier)
property_snapshot.Origin: Diablo 2 — Horadric artifact, transmutation via recipes

property_snapshot.Name: Nightwind
property_snapshot.Notes: Sentient artifact shadow bastard sword (+3). Tier 1 (355 GURPS pts). Wielder chain: Selarial Moonshadow (deceased) → Arik Baen'und → Lirien Nightwalker (current). Shadow-forged steel, bypasses DR/magic, DR/cold iron, DR/silver. 18–20 crit range. Shadow Rend: +2d6 negative energy per hit. Spiritual Pressure: HD-differential Shadow Weight (not fear, not mind-affecting — progressive paralysis scaled by power gap). Soul Hunger with SP economy fueling active abilities. Shadow Step 5/day. Shadow Ward (spell absorption/reflection). Shadow Grasping (Evard's tentacles from targets' own shadows). Shadow Network Anchor (6 waypoints, Veil backbone). Acid Fang evolution path: kill Maladrax (CR 21 ancient black, Vast Swamp) → consume soul → blade evolves to +4 with unified corrosive spiritual pressure. Full mechanical rebuild completed 2026-06-01.

property_snapshot.Name: Ring of Baal'amon
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Thick gold band, perpetually cold. Abyssal inscription: 'Baal'amon' (The Frozen Betrayer / Winter's Last General). Contains animated scene of frozen battlefield with demon corpses, massive demonic figure collapsed at center with mortal blade in heart. Ice trail forms where wearer walks.

PROPERTIES (11 charges/day, refresh at dawn):
• Cold Resistance (passive)
• Winter's Fortitude: Advantage on CON saves below freezing
• Speak/understand Abyssal
• Demonic Authority (1 charge): CR 5 or lower fiends WIS DC 15 or frightened 1 min
• Sleet Storm (3 charges): No concentration
• Ice Storm 5th level (5 charges): Black ice with red veins
• Ice Form (hidden power, 1/day): Transform to perfect ice sculpture, immune to ALL damage, 1 hour, can't move/act

SIDE EFFECTS:
• Fiends always sense you've slain their kind (disadvantage on Deception vs fiends)
• Extreme cold triggers Baal'amon's dying memories as whispers
• Killing fiends shows their final moments in the winter scene
• Leaves thin ice trail when walking
• Prophetic nightmares of coming winter/doom

EVOLUTION TIERS:
• Tier 2 (Stirring): Glacial Genesis, Omtose Phellack Resonance, Whisper Clarity
• Tier 3 (Awakened): Raise Glacier, Sublimation Engine, Baal'amon's Hold

HISTORY: 2,800 years old, 8 previous owners including a Modron who catalogued it (#7734-B-Cold-Artifact-Demonic). Baal'amon commanded three legions during Blood War's 'Frozen Offensive.' Reached Hell through mortal trading souls for it.

JAGHUT CONNECTION: Part of an 'insurance network' of artifacts left by fleeing Jaghut. Connected to Ice Crown of Hrothgar (transmuted), Omtose Phellack magic. 'There are more.'

property_snapshot.Name: Ring of Arcturus
property_snapshot.Notes:
PHYSICAL: Two-finger ring of Calimshan gold, organic web pattern connecting middle and ring fingers. Star sapphire (quail's egg size) contains visible pacing figure. Always warm. Cannot be removed while attuned. Leaves Lichtenberg electrical scarring after heavy use.

CONTAINED SOUL: Arcturus the Storm Sage - Netherese combat mage obsessed with 'solidifying energy into graspable form.' Killed during magical duel when he tried to grasp opponent's lightning bolt. Final words: 'See? Tangible! Note this down!'

SPELLS (Charges refresh at dawn):
• Greater Invisibility (2/day): 1 min, doesn't break on attacks
• Mass Confusion (1/day): 30ft radius, WIS DC 17
• Dominate Person (1/day): 1 hour, WIS DC 17
• Judrajim's Barrier (6/day): 10x10 ft wall of force, AC 18, 25 HP, 10 min
• Bolt of the Gods (2/day): 7th level - can be held as +2 melee weapon (4d8 lightning) or thrown (8d6 lightning, 5ft radius, 120ft range)

CURSE EFFECTS:
• Electrical Scarring: Lichtenberg figures after extended use
• Academic Compulsion: Daily INT DC 15 or 10-min lecture
• Sympathetic Shock: +1d6 psychic damage from lightning attacks (Arcturus critiques positioning)

RELATIONSHIP SYSTEM: -5 to +5 scale tracking Arcturus's disposition. Creative spell use gains points, repetitive casting loses them. At -3: 10% spell failure. At +5: New spell development possible.

ORIGIN: Created by Arik's Dodecahedron, extracting Arcturus's soul from Tempest's collection. Gold from lightning-struck mountain veins.

SYNERGIES: Bolt of the Gods conducts through Kiss of Betrayal (blood blade). Barriers compensate for lost flight.
property_snapshot.Origin: Netherese — soul trapped in star sapphire
